card.name: Linking words after dose-adjust phrases
card.fires_on: The small word right after "according", "based", or "basis" in dosing instructions, such as to, on, upon, or of. It also fires on words like if or has that introduce a condition.

modes.label: Adjust according to / based on
modes.description: The word that follows "according" or "based" in instructions to adjust or individualize a dose.
modes.example: Adjust the dosage according<< to>> blood pressure response.

modes.label: Other linking verbs and conjunctions
modes.description: A word like if or has that introduces a condition or a requirement in dosing or use instructions.
